name: Strong
purpose: Makes a few words of a line bold, where they say what the rest of it is, such as Expired before a date, or 1 year 28 days before remaining.

proposed.design: a screenshot of the future driving designs in Figma, until there’s a link to the file

origin.notes: SwiftUI draws part of a line in bold by joining Texts with +, or from an AttributedString. The app doesn't do it today; the future driving designs do, in semibold, as GovKit's emphasis is.

inputs.content: The words to make bold. Put it inside a <govuk-app-text>, around the words, and it takes that text's size and colour.

rules: Bold only the words that say what the rest of the line is, such as Expired before a date.
For a whole line in bold, give the text emphasis instead. For a heading, use the heading.
Use it once in a line at most: more, and nothing stands out.
